rapport_notes: Warm, natural tone with light humor ('getting that late workout'); friendly throughout; no awkward pauses or tension.
process_discipline_notes: After 'does that all make sense?' the rep immediately asks 'do you have any questions for me?' without silence—no pause allowed for processing.

evidence_quotes.agenda: before I go on to go over the details, do you have any specific questions or concerns that you would like answered on this call?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised no concerns; said 'No, not at the moment, no.' No follow-up was possible or needed. Two-layers N/A—full credit per rubric exception.
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with: We got our no dirt, no worries damage coverage. Which is our free evaluation coverage included in our hourly rate provides up to $2,000 per move to repair, replace or reimburse for accidental damages.
evidence_quotes.sheet2_whos_coming: The mover feature. A few days before you move. You'll receive a meet your move email introducing them to you helping ease attention of strangers arriving at your front door.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: we do have our on time guarantee we value your time. So, if we can't make it in the time window that way. Arranged start discounting money of your final bill.
evidence_quotes.communication: A few days before you move. You'll receive a meet your move email introducing them to you.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: a typical move for the size...usually about fifteen to 25 boxes you feel like you would fall within that range.
evidence_quotes.beats_it_pay_less: once we go over that minimum the time is prorated in fifteen minute increments.
evidence_quotes.missing_save_your_ass: No 'commit to the rate' framing (100k moves experience); no 'estimate is a window because your move is yours' (factors named); no self-prep tip; no 'does that feel fair?' with silence.

top_strength: Asked the agenda question cleanly before any probing, and when the customer said no concerns, moved naturally into logistics without over-pitching—a genuine conversational flow.
coaching_note: Quid pro quo framing is completely missing: the rep never said 'let me ask you a few quick questions to get an accurate quote' or equivalent. Add that at the very start after the warm greeting. Also, after 'does that make sense?' hold silence and let them respond—don't immediately ask 'do you have questions?'
